description: SPENDS THE ACCOUNT OWNER’S CREDITS. Only after the owner approves the price from soclo_motion_effects_quote: pass the same sourceAssetId, quoteId and expectedCredits exactly as quoted, and the quote’s requestId (reuse it on any repeat). A new copy is saved and the original is always kept. A 15 s Motion video is usually ready in about 5 minutes and a 60 s one in up to about 15 minutes; Add effects usually takes a few minutes. If the outcome is unknown, do NOT make again: call soclo_motion_status with the original requestId.

expectedCredits.description: The exact credits from the quote. A ceiling, not an estimate.

note.description: Optional extra wishes from the owner, in their words.

quoteId.description: The quoteId exactly as the quote returned it.

requestId.description: One id per owner approval, as the quote returned it: required to make and to check status; reuse the same one on any repeat.

sourceAssetId.description: The Library video to add effects to (any length).

name: soclo_motion_effects_make
title: Add effects to a video
